title: Alert
description: One item of the DynamoDB `alerts` table, as returned by GET /alerts?flightId=&since=. Partition key `flightId`, sort key `alertKey`. An alert without `closedAt` is still open.

alertKey.description: Sort key: <openedAt>#<sensorId>#<rule>. openedAt is 13-digit epoch millis so keys sort by time.

openedAt.description: Epoch millis derived from the data, never from the wall clock, so the alertKey is identical on every redelivery and a redelivered open is a no-op under a conditional put. Per rule: threshold and rate_of_change = ts of the first offending reading; drift and flatline = ts of the first reading of the sustained run (window start); dropout = start of the first missing second (second * 1000).

peakValue.description: Most extreme value seen while open. Null for dropout, which has no value.

detail.description: Human-readable reason, shown in the SNS email.

closedAt.description: Epoch millis derived from the data. Per rule: threshold, rate_of_change, drift and flatline = ts of the first reading back to normal; dropout = start of the first present second (second * 1000), since a corrupt-only second has no reading.
